title: Unit 16 Consolidation: the Mexican Revolution
goal: Review the Mexican Revolution, from Díaz to Cárdenas, with the grammar of Unit 16.

items: I can say how long something had been going on, with *llevar* + gerund, to describe the Porfiriato.
I can report what Díaz and the Plan of San Luis said, with reported speech.
I can tell the story of Zapata and Villa with the preterite and the imperfect.
I can describe the Constitution of 1917 with relative clauses that take a preposition.
I can say what was done after the Revolution, with the passive with *ser*.
